evaluation_protocol.candidate_space: Distinct target_assignee values observed in training only
evaluation_protocol.unseen_target_policy: Retain in evaluation; do not convert to negatives, do not silently discard

operational_target.definition: First post-Creation assignment to a specific assignee

forbidden_features: any current/final value used as historical backfill

candidate_space.definition: Distinct target_assignee values observed in the training portion only

evaluation_metrics.unseen_target_evaluation: reported separately; never converted into negatives

target.definition: First post-Creation assignment to a specific assignee.

ranking_pipeline.representation: TF-IDF representation of Creation-time ticket text constructed from Creator, Creator Detail, Summary, and Description.
ranking_pipeline.retrieval: Retrieve the most similar historical training tickets for each evaluation ticket.
ranking_pipeline.candidate_generation: Collect assignees associated with retrieved historical tickets.
ranking_pipeline.candidate_scoring: Aggregate historical similarity evidence by assignee to produce a ranked candidate list.

evaluation_metrics.coverage: Report the proportion of evaluation tickets for which the historical ranking pipeline can generate candidates.

evaluation_stratification.required_comparison: Compare ranking performance across historical assignee-support buckets.

retrieval.aggregation: sum of similarity evidence by historical assignee

target.meaning_positive: First observed post-Creation Dupe of addition
target.meaning_negative: No observed post-Creation Dupe of addition through the administrative observation endpoint

split_definition.official_boundary: Creation year < 2024 = training; Creation year >= 2024 = evaluation
split_definition.crossing_group_action: All five crossing groups assigned to TRAIN to preserve group integrity

interpretation: The audit discovered the native T4/T5 project artifacts and inspected their available contracts, split/prediction/model files, CSV metadata, and implementation signals. This operation does not itself establish that a particular development population is eligible for prediction generation. Exact split provenance, prediction boundary, candidate semantics, and population overlap must be reviewed from the discovered native artifacts before generation.
decision: PASS — sufficient native artifact evidence was discovered to proceed to targeted T4/T5 split-provenance and population verification; development prediction generation remains blocked until that verification is completed.
